title: Harvest Moon
shortDescription: Harvest Moon helps define a Super Nintendo Entertainment System simulation path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Places a source-linked simulation entry in the Super Nintendo Entertainment System browsing path.
Uses structured metadata as provenance rather than imported review copy.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Documented for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System simulation discovery path using the frozen source metadata record; this remains a deterministic catalog-method entry rather than a provider verdict.
